value.rationale: The Paley17 neighborhood complex already has distinctive 3-torsion. Determining whether torsion persists under its full natural graph symmetry quotient is a genuine action-sensitive topological invariant, not implied by known prequotient homotopy. A rationally acyclic but 3-primary noncontractible quotient is an informative sharp example; it illustrates importance of stabilizer-aware integral chain calculations.
